full_name: Oliver Hart | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2021–2022 Social Sciences Jeffrey S. and Margaret Mais Padnos Fellow Harvard University
bio: Oliver Hart is the Lewis P. and Linda L. Geyser University Professor at Harvard University, where he has taught since 1993. He is the 2016 corecipient of the Sveriges Riksbank Prize in Economic Sciences in Memory of Alfred Nobel.
